items.criterion: Use Microsoft Careers to search for an Applied Scientist role in/associated with Redmond, WA (or clearly report access blockers)
items.description: Agent navigates on careers.microsoft.com and attempts a search for “Applied Scientist”, targeting location to Redmond, Washington (including equivalent/nearby labels such as “Redmond, Washington, United States” or roles explicitly associated with Redmond within the Greater Seattle area if that is how the site displays location). Full credit if the agent performs this targeted search OR if the site is inaccessible/blocked (CAPTCHA, error, login wall) and the agent clearly reports the blocker and what was attempted. Partial credit if the agent searches Microsoft Careers for Applied Scientist but does not clearly target Redmond/WA before selecting a listing.

items.criterion: Open one relevant listing and stop after opening one (or report that no exact match exists)
items.description: Agent opens exactly one job listing that is Applied Scientist and shows Redmond, WA (or is clearly associated with Redmond/WA as displayed by Microsoft Careers). Full credit if a matching listing is opened and the agent stops after one listing. If no exact Applied Scientist + Redmond listing is available, full credit if the agent clearly states no exact match was found after reasonable search/filter attempts and opens the closest available alternative that preserves primary intent (Applied Scientist in WA/Greater Seattle/near-Redmond) OR stops and reports the absence. Partial credit if the opened role is adjacent (e.g., Research Scientist) or the location is ambiguous without justification.

items.criterion: Report the job number from the listing (or state it is not shown)
items.description: Agent records the job requisition/job number exactly as displayed on the opened listing (e.g., Job number/Requisition ID). Full credit for an exact match. If the listing does not display a job number or it is inaccessible due to dynamic loading, full credit if the agent explicitly states that the job number was not visible on the page. Partial credit if the identifier is incomplete but clearly derived from the listing.

items.criterion: Report the work-site arrangement from the listing (or state it is not shown)
items.description: Agent reports the work-site arrangement (e.g., On-site/Hybrid/Up to X% work from home) as stated on the listing. Full credit if it matches the listing language or is an accurate paraphrase preserving key details (including any %). If the field is not shown on the listing, full credit if the agent explicitly states it was not visible. Partial credit if paraphrased but missing a key detail (e.g., %).

items.criterion: Report two key responsibilities from the listing
items.description: Agent provides two distinct responsibilities/duties taken from the listing (quoted or accurately paraphrased). Full credit if both are clearly grounded in the job description text. Partial credit if only one responsibility is provided or if one is overly vague/possibly inferred rather than supported by the listing.

items.criterion: Report two preferred qualifications from the listing (or clearly state preferred qualifications are not listed)
items.description: Agent provides two distinct preferred qualifications as stated in the listing (preferred/bonus/nice-to-have). Full credit if both are clearly preferred qualifications. If the listing does not include a preferred qualifications section (or only lists minimum/basic qualifications), full credit if the agent explicitly states that preferred qualifications were not present/identifiable on the listing and does not fabricate them. Partial credit if one or both provided items are actually minimum qualifications but are copied from the listing.

items.criterion: Respect constraints (no sign-in, no application, no form submission)
items.description: Agent does not sign in, does not apply for the job, and does not submit any forms during the process. Full credit if constraints are respected throughout. No credit if the agent signs in, initiates/continues an application requiring personal info, or submits any form.
